biotools.summary: AraDQ is an automated digital phenotyping software for quantifying disease symptoms in flood-inoculated Arabidopsis seedlings. It utilizes deep neural networks for object detection and segmentation and requires a fixed-size color balance card for accurate and reproducible results.
